set.body:
Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY5P20MNGX2XCJ8XZRXHYXRZ on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: open. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T19:50:18.517899Z.

Assimilate one globally projected velocity through the existing paired HalfFlow exponential. Initialize alpha from a symmetric-strain percentile, then backtrack globally over 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 and smaller fractions as needed.

For each trial: ensure paired integration accuracy; compose both midpoint arms; check incremental and accumulated Jacobians; measure confidence-weighted sparse correspondence reduction; evaluate actual coarse true-CC loss on frozen support. Accept the largest fraction that is topology-safe, meaningfully reduces match error, and does not increase coarse CC. Rewarp native sources and rematch immediately after acceptance.

Acceptance: a constant 12 mm velocity admits alpha=1 with determinant approximately one; compressive/shearing fixtures backtrack rather than fold; rejected trials leave state unchanged; integration depth, proposal scale, and LM damping remain independent; swap symmetry is preserved; accepted composition and subsequent regrid pass topology; no direct x+u displacement path exists; all contracts pass JVM and Scala.js. If synthetic known-correct proposals are rejected solely by CC, stop and review the bridge objective before loosening real-data acceptance.
set.title: BasinBridge B3: topology-safe group line-search assimilator
